author: Favio Leiva
source: INEI, Censos Nacionales 2025; compiled census workbook and supplied geography.
identity: Ethnic self-identification is independent of childhood language.
geography: Sangani aggregated into Perene only for mapping. Callao is a region with one province. 182 population differences against geographic attributes remain unresolved.
percentages: Exploratory: all-age population denominator; official question universe and response exclusivity remain unconfirmed.
diversity: 1-HHI over ETH_01 to ETH_63; ETH_64 nonresponse excluded.
presence: Number of ETH_01 to ETH_63 categories with population > 0; residual categories included; ETH_64 nonresponse excluded. Counted after territorial aggregation.
presence_hover: All present categories sorted by person count descending; scrollable hover and full selected-district list.

country_outline.method: Exterior rings of the union of supplied district polygons; internal district boundaries excluded. Same contour clipped to Lima-Callao.

correlation.unit: mapped district; each district has equal weight
correlation.phi: Pearson correlation of binary presence (count > 0), also called phi; uses all districts including joint absences.
correlation.spearman: Pearson correlation of average ranks of district percentages; zero shares and tied ranks retained. Percentages use the existing exploratory all-age denominator.
correlation.joint: Number of districts with count > 0 for both groups.
correlation.ordering: National population descending; same order on both axes.
correlation.missing: No missing counts; all denominators positive. Input completeness is asserted, not imputed.
correlation.interpretation: Ecological territorial association, not individual joint identity or causation. Shared zeros, sparse distributions and the common percentage denominator affect interpretation.

maxima_exploration: Click either national or Lima-Callao map to open the shared zoom/pan explorer; table rows retain selection and highlighting.
